models_evaluated: Google Programmable Search Engine (regex-based ATC extraction benchmark)

links.outcome: Acceptable ATC classification of GPT-4o vs search-based algorithm on same sample
links.effect: GPT-4o at least mostly correct 92.5% (185/200, 80% CI 90.1%-94.9%); search-based algorithm 82.5% (165/200) acceptable.
links.quote: For the search-based algorithm, 82.5% (165/200) were deemed acceptable.

unlisted_practices: Chain-of-thought prompting to reason about drug dose when classifying ATC codes from real-world data

screen.reason: Empirical validation of LLM prompting (chain-of-thought) for drug classification in health data/pharmacoepidemiology against a search-based baseline.
